reason: The README identifies dsh-vision as an image-understanding plugin that forwards images to configured vision models or local OCR and injects observations into the current DeepSeek Harness request.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解能力，通过配置的视觉模型或本地 OCR 分析图片并辅助生成回答。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding to DeepSeek Harness by analyzing attachments with configured vision models or local OCR to support response generation.

capabilities: Analyzes image attachments with configured cloud vision services
Uses local macOS Vision OCR or Tesseract as fallback
Routes vision observations into the current model request
Stores provider credentials through the host application's credential service
